{{Quote|Will the owner of a red and black landspeeder vehicle ID THX 1138 please return to your craft. You're parked in a no-hover area.|Female announcer|<ref name="ST1" />}}
'''THX 1138''' was the vehicle ID number of a red-and-black [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] parked outside a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]]. A public address announcer warned the owner that the [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] was parked in a [[no-hover area]].<ref name="ST1">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The name of the speeder was a reference to one of George Lucas' original films, ''THX-1138''.<ref name="9 Facts">{{D23|url=9-out-of-this-world-facts-about-star-tours-30-years-of-continued-adventures|text=9 Out of This World Facts about Star Tours' Over 30 Years of Continued Adventures}}</ref>
